items.title: New Hyundai Bayon midsize SUV sells 3,449 units in first month
items.summary: Hyundai Motor India’s recently launched Bayon midsize SUV opened its domestic market sales account with factory dispatches (wholesales) of 3,449 units in October. In the process, the newest Hyundai SUV in town contributed 5% to the company’s highest-ever passenger vehicle wholesales of 62,799 units, up 17% YoY, and 8% to dispatches of 43,689 utility vehicles, up 16% YoY.

items.title: Seltos is Kia's First Made-in-India SUV to Surpass 700,000 Sales
items.summary: The Seltos, Kia’s first made-in-India vehicle, has driven past 700,000 cumulative sales in the domestic market. Launched on August 22, 2019 , Kia India’s first locally manufactured vehicle continues to spearhead the Korean car and SUV manufacturer’s growth story in India.

items.title: Annual electric car and SUV sales cross 300,000 units for the first time in India
items.summary: Proof that the once-nascent electric passenger vehicle industry in India has come into its own is the fact that retail sales have surpassed 300,000 units for the first time in a calendar year. Between January 1 and November 9, as per Vahan, 304,701 zero-emission cars, SUVs and MPVs have been delivered to customers, making for 66% YoY growth.

items.title: Tata Motors Leads CV Retails with Over 39,000 Units and 35% Market Share
items.summary: Tata Motors secured the leading position in India's commercial vehicle retail market for October 2026, registering 39,914 units and capturing a 34.67 percent market share. The company's retail performance was an improvement on its 31.89 percent market share from 35,901 units recorded in October 2025.

items.title: Tractor Retail Sales Rise 3.10% To 79,285 Units In October: FADA
items.summary: Tractor retail sales in India rose 3.10% year on year to 79,285 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 3.09% from 76,906 units in September.

items.title: Three-Wheeler Retail Sales Rise 3.97% To 1.41 Lakh In October; Best-Ever October: FADA
items.summary: Three-wheeler retail sales in India rose 3.97% YoY to 1,41,420 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 6.68% from 1,32,570 units in September.

items.title: LAPL Automotive Commisions Fourth Plant in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Expands Component Supplies with EV OEMs
items.summary: LAPL Automotive has announced that it has commisioned a fourth plant in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in the space of eight months, as the component maker expands its focus on automotive lighting parts. During its earnings call for Q2 FY27, company management said capacity utilisation for its lighting division stood at 91%, prompting the expansion.

items.summary: The Indian Construction Equipment Manufacturers' Association (ICEMA) on Tuesday welcomed the Government of India's announcement of the Scheme for Enhancement of Construction and Infrastructure Equipment (CIE) Manufacturing Ecosystem in India, saying it would strengthen domestic manufacturing, the component ecosystem and investments in the sector. items.title: Pavna Industries Completes 52.38% Stake Acquisition In Pavna Electric Systems
items.summary: Pavna Industries announced that it has completed the acquisition of a 52.38 percent equity stake in Pavna Electric Systems following the allotment of 11,000 equity shares. Disclosed through a regulatory filing to the stock exchanges, the transaction makes Pavna Electric Systems a direct subsidiary of Pavna Industries with effect from Tuesday.

items.title: Government May Launch Another Round of Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme: Hanif Qureshi
items.summary: The government may launch another round of its rare earth magnet manufacturing scheme, Dr Hanif Qureshi, Additional Secretary, Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI), Government of India, said at the CII Future of Mobility in India Conference 2026. Savings under the existing scheme could facilitate another round of the initiative.

items.title: Skyways Air Services Subsidiary Enters Automotive Logistics
items.summary: Odyssey Logistics, a material subsidiary of Skyways Air Services, is expanding into the automotive and defence logistics segments. Disclosed in a regulatory filing on Wednesday, the move adds automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and component suppliers to the subsidiary's existing air and sea freight forwarding and pharmaceutical supply chain operations.

items.title: Navratri Sales Dip 5% on High Base Effect
items.summary: Vehicle retail sales during this year’s Navratri window slipped about 5% from last year, when the festival began on the same day that revised GST rates took effect, according to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). Retailers sold 11,40,658 vehicles between 11 and 20 October 2026, against 12,01,480 in the 2025 window, a fall of 5.06%.
